name: gizza-ai/period-predictor
summary: Predict upcoming periods, ovulation and fertile windows

tool.description: Predict a person's upcoming menstrual periods from the first day of their most recent period. cycle_length is the average days between period starts (default 28), period_length is how many days bleeding lasts (default 5), luteal_phase is the days before a period that ovulation happens (default 14), and cycles is how many future cycles to project (default 6). Returns each predicted cycle's period start date and weekday, bleeding-end date, estimated ovulation day (period start − luteal phase) and 6-day fertile window (five days before ovulation through ovulation day), plus the next period start and a human-readable summary. Estimates only — not a contraceptive method or medical advice. Runs locally.

last_period.description: The first day of the most recent period. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, RFC-3339 (with Z/offset), and common variants like YYYY/MM/DD, MM/DD/YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY.

cycle_length.description: Average cycle length in days — first day of one period to the first day of the next. Default 28. Accepts 20–45.

period_length.description: How many days the bleeding lasts, used for each cycle's end date. Default 5. Accepts 1–14.

luteal_phase.description: Luteal-phase length in days, used to estimate ovulation (period start − luteal phase). Default 14. Accepts 9–17.

cycles.description: How many upcoming cycles to predict. Default 6. Accepts 1–24.
